cleanup_failed: Could not stop the abandoned Codex start in pane {pane}. No new tab will be opened until it can be closed: {reason}
command_line_too_long: The Codex message and launcher arguments need {units} UTF-16 units; Windows allows {limit}. Nothing was sent. Shorten the first message.

no_box_here: Codex started in the pane you picked, but its input box didn’t appear within {seconds} seconds. The pane is left as it is.
